verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a speech-to-text API, so custom vocabulary or keyword boosting is a fair axis for it. However, the documented job parameters cover only language, diarization, channels, confidence filtering, segment duration, redaction and user agent, with no vocabulary, hint or boosting option. The confidence-threshold filter is an adjacent control and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can boost domain terms, names, and jargon through custom vocabulary or keyword boosting so they transcribe correctly
